# Project Maya — Technical Summary

## What it is
Project Maya is a free, open-source local inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash), with its own quantized model packs ("Maya-S/M/L/XS") that run on consumer hardware by tiering experts across VRAM → pinned RAM → NVMe SSD.

## Key architecture points
- **Expert tiering**: routed experts (95% of parameters) are cached in VRAM, pinned in RAM, or streamed from SSD
